content: Cefuroxime axetil dosage and administration guidelines are as follows: 1. Important Note on Bioequivalence: CEFTIN tablets and CEFTIN for oral suspension are not bioequivalent. They cannot be substituted on a milligram-per-milligram basis. Refer to the clinical pharmacology section for further details. 2. CEFTIN Tablets: The safety and effectiveness of CEFTIN tablets for treating acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis have not been established when administered for less than 10 days. 3. CEFTIN for Oral Suspension: CEFTIN for oral suspension is approved for use in pediatric patients aged 3 months to 12 years. Dosages should be determined based on the guidelines provided in Table 8. The safety and efficacy of cefuroxime axetil in patients with renal failure have not been established. Since cefuroxime is eliminated through the kidneys, its half-life is prolonged in individuals with renal impairment. 4. Instructions for Mixing CEFTIN for Oral Suspension: Before preparing the suspension, shake the bottle to loosen the powder. Remove the cap from the bottle. Add the total amount of water required for reconstitution (refer to Table 9 for the exact volume). Replace the cap securely. Invert the bottle and rock it vigorously from side to side to allow the water to mix with the powder. 5. Storage and Usage Instructions: Shake the oral suspension well before each use. After each use, securely replace the cap. Store the reconstituted suspension in a refrigerator at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). Discard any unused suspension after 10 days.
